text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Noooo waaaay!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As I was walking down the hallway, I 
suddenly heard a loud voice.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
No, no, no! I am NOT going to 
supplementary lessons! I don't need those 
to get a good test score!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
――W-What is it?! Are you going to tell me 
to "take supplementary lessons!" like the 
teacher did?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
No way, absolutely not! Besides, what's 
wrong with being a little late to class 
just for practicing magic?! You should 
just let it slide!

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho-san! Return to the classroom 
at once!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Eep!? The teacher's coming! What do I do, 
what do I do~~?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'm tell-ing you-!! I said I don't wanna 
do that!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
While we're standing here talking, Sensei 
is gonna...! Isn't there some good way—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: —Ah!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Shut up! Just stand right there and 
stay still!

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho-san! Where are you, Sweep 
Tosho-san!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Phew~, there she goes.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmph♪ You make a pretty decent wall, you 
know.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Keep today a secret, and maybe I'll let 
you use it again.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Someday, the time may come when they 
use me as a wall again.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I-I was planning to do that anyway! I'm 
definitely going to outrun you from start 
to finish, just you watch!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, I could see her running away 
through the window.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh~, now that I've made it this far, 
it's a breeze♪ Catch me if you can!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? What's all the commotion?

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove-san, perfect timing! She is 
running away from remedial classes...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Huh... No way, really!? No way!!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Oho, I see. Letting your guard down proved 
to be your undoing.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Noooo!! No, no, noooo!! Let go!! Let go of 
meeee!!
